verses.text: A song. A psalm of Asaph. God, do not stay silent. Do not be quiet. Do not stay still, God.
Look, your enemies are in an uproar. Those who hate you are raising their heads proudly.
They make clever plans against your people. They plot against those you treasure.
They say, "Come, let's wipe them out as a nation, so the name of Israel will never be remembered again."
They have agreed on a plan together. They have joined forces against you:
the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia and the people of Tyre.
Even Assyria has joined them to give strength to the descendants of Lot. Selah.
Do to them what you did to Midian, and to Sisera and Jabin at the Kishon River.
They were destroyed at Endor, and their bodies became like manure on the ground.
Make their important men like Oreb and Zeeb. Make all their leaders like Zebah and Zalmunna,
who said, "Let's take for ourselves the pasturelands of God."
My God, make them like tumbleweeds, like chaff blown by the wind.
As fire burns a forest and as a flame sets the mountains on fire,
chase them with your storm. Terrify them with your hurricane.
Cover their faces with shame, so they will look for your name, LORD.
Let them be put to shame and terrified forever. Let them die in disgrace.
Then they will know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.
